headline: Kitchens, and the makers behind them
intro: A kitchen worktop does more work than any other surface in a building: water at the sink, spills, knocks on the edge and years of daily cleaning. Each project below shows one of those jobs and how Polygood® handles it. If you make kitchens, this edition is also an open call to work with us.

cases.title: Maison Kyka
cases.headline: An edge with nothing to peel off
cases.body: Samji Studio made the Terrazzo Nuovo worktops for two compact Maison Kyka apartment kitchens in Paris, one in the 7th arrondissement and one near Saint-Germain in the 6th.
cases.image_alt: Compact Paris kitchen with beige cabinets, wavy timber handles and a Terrazzo Nuovo worktop with a wave-cut front edge

story.label: The challenge.
story.text: In a small kitchen the front edge takes the knocks: hips, bags, wet hands. On many worktops that edge is a strip glued over the core, and it is often the first thing to lift.

story.label: How Polygood answers it.
story.text: Polygood is the same material all the way through, so a worktop needs no edge protection. In the 6th, Samji cut the edge into a wave that echoes the cabinet handles and left it bare.

story.label: Over the years.
story.text: There is no strip to come away, and a mark on a satin finish can be sanded out rather than the worktop replaced.

cases.title: Thermoformed kitchen
cases.headline: A curve made with heat, not joints
cases.body: A private client in Paris asked Samji Studio for a kitchen worktop and a table to match. Samji made both in Emerald Ghost, a flecked sea green. It is the only thermoformed kitchen in our project archive so far.
cases.image_alt: Emerald Ghost kitchen worktop and matching table in a Paris flat with a concrete ceiling, timber cabinets and herringbone parquet

story.label: The challenge.
story.text: Curves are hard in most worktop materials. They are built up from pieces or left out, and every joint is another line to keep clean.

story.label: How Polygood answers it.
story.text: Polygood can be thermoformed. Samji heated the panel until it softened, shaped it over a mould and let it cool into a curve, in the same pattern as the table.

story.label: Over the years.
story.text: A bend instead of a joint means one less line for dirt to collect in, and the panel holds its new shape once it has cooled.

cases.title: Station Road
cases.headline: A white worktop that is easy to look after
cases.body: WUNSCH, cabinetmakers who design and make bespoke kitchens in their Lewes workshop in Sussex, cut and fitted this worktop on Station Road in White Lollipop: a white ground with small flecks of colour.
cases.image_alt: Kitchen with mustard-yellow cabinet fronts, green glazed tiles, a brass tap and a White Lollipop worktop with small coloured flecks

story.label: The challenge.
story.text: A white worktop is the one clients hesitate over. Everyday spills show on a pale surface, and they worry it will look tired in a few years.

story.label: How Polygood answers it.
story.text: In our stain test with 20 everyday agents, most left no trace on Polygood. Daily cleaning is a pH-neutral cleaner or a little washing-up liquid, nothing stronger.

story.label: Over the years.
story.text: A mark that does stay can be sanded out, so the surface is renewed rather than replaced, and the panels carry a 10-year limited warranty for interior use.

cases.title: Commerzbank
cases.headline: Built for the sink and the next refit
cases.body: CBRE Design Collective designed the staff pantry in Commerzbank's Amsterdam office in Zuidas, with countertops in Timeless Duo Blue: a white ground with blue flecks.
cases.image_alt: Office pantry at Commerzbank Amsterdam with a Timeless Duo Blue countertop, an undermount steel sink, blue glazed tiles and teal cabinets

story.label: The challenge.
story.text: An office pantry is used by many people all day. Water sits around the sink, food is prepared on the counter, and an office fit-out rarely lasts as long as the building.

story.label: How Polygood answers it.
story.text: Polygood absorbs no moisture, so the steel sink is mounted under the countertop with the edge of the cut-out left bare. The material is tested for food contact under EU Regulation 10/2011.

story.label: Over the years.
story.text: When the pantry is refitted, the countertops can come back to us through our take-back programme. Polygood is a single material and 100% recyclable.

partner.heading: We're looking for kitchen makers
partner.body:
We'd like to work with more kitchen studios, cabinetmakers and worktop fabricators on joint projects in Polygood.

Polygood is worked with standard woodworking tools, and we support you with samples, our technical guide, adhesive matrix and care guide. Tell us about your workshop and the kitchens you make. When a project is finished, we share it on polygood.com and in this newsletter, credited to the people who made it.
